label: preparing
what: Likely preparations for a jubilee gathering or celebration in the great hall at 18:00, presented to the mayor as a lighting inspection. Innkeeper commissioned bread and directed hall placement; baker prepared jubilee loaves; builder arranged the precisely timed inspection and requested entry not earlier than six. Freight knowingly supplied grain/payment and delivered bread, but his knowledge of any surprise is not established. Secretary arranged the escort openly; neither secretary nor neighbour is shown knowingly concealing a celebration. The mayor was told about the bread and inspection, so concealment of the overall celebratory purpose, not total secrecy, is the supported inference.
